summary: Responsive SpendWarden email template plus a FastMCP server exposing health, render_template and send_email. The MCP stdio client listed the tools and called send_email; the OnionMail SMTP endpoint timed out, so the server wrote a real RFC822 .eml and HTML preview to outbox/ and reported mode=dry-run rather than claiming a send.
observations: template.html is a 600px, inline-CSS, table-layout email with a mobile media query and plain-text fallback
server.py exposes health, render_template and send_email over FastMCP
client_demo.py connected over stdio, listed ['health','render_template','send_email'] and called send_email
the send produced an RFC822 message in outbox/ with a Message-ID and an HTML preview
SMTP to smtp.onionmail.org:465 timed out from this network; no fake send is claimed
the server supports real SMTP via SMTP_HOST/SMTP_PORT/SMTP_USER/SMTP_PASS
